 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Rajeev Ranjan Prasad
 Oral Order

6 18-12-2023 I.A. No.2 of 2022 This application has been filed seeking condonation of delay of 458 days in filing of the revision application against the judgment dated 20.12.2019 passed in Cr. Appeal No.
06/2016/C.I.S. No.-06/2016.

In view of the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India in Suo Motu Writ (Civil) No.5 of 2020, the period between 23rd March, 2020 to 20th March, 2022 are being excluded from counting the limitation.

In view of this, the delay in filing of the revision Patna High Court CR. REV. No.422 of 2021(6)
dt.18-12-2023 application is condoned.
I.A. No.2 of 2022 is disposed of accordingly.
This application has been filed seeking exemption from surrender under Rule 57A of the Rules of Patna High Court.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that by the impugned judgment, the petitioners have been convicted for the offences under Section 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code and they have been ordered to undergo rigorous imprisonment for three years and a fine of Rs.5,000/- each and in default of payment of fine to undergo six months more rigorous imprisonment only.
Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that he may be granted some time to file medical certificates of the petitioners in support of their contention in I.A. No.1 of 2022.
Let this matter be listed on 11.01.2024 to enable learned counsel for the petitioners to file the medical prescriptions.

Considering that the opposite party no.2 is not Patna High Court CR. REV. No.422 of 2021(6)
dt.18-12-2023 appearing to contest this matter despite notice issued to her, for the present, no coercive action shall be taken against the petitioners.

(Rajeev Ranjan Prasad, J) arvind/-
